{{Quote|The huge machines raised their weapons toward the collected civilians and sprayed them with jets of glistening stream.|[[Chen Ming-di]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
The '''carbonite war droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Another variant called the "[[incinerator war droid]]" was a droid that had its [[carbonite projector]] replaced with a [[flamethrower]].

==Characteristics==
This [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] stood several [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was armed with a [[carbonite projector]] and a large [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shield]]. It would use the [[carbonite]] projector to immobilize its enemies, as well as freeze objects and spray a cloud of smoke in an area.

==History==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the Empire created a vast number of war droids with fire and ice attachments. Several of these droids were utilized in [[Rhador]], encasing multiple people in carbonite and then proceeding to wipe out the entire village. These were then used as combat units for the defense on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], and in ambushing the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] on the Battle near the Itani Nebula. However, none of the carbonite war droids were used in attacking the said battleship.

[[File:Carbonite_war_droid_Starkiller.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Subject 1138|Starkiller]] attacks a carbonite war droid.]]

A [[Subject 1138|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]] encountered and destroyed several carbonite war droids on Kamino, and in Cato Neimoidia by ripping off their shields with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and utilizing their own weapons against them, making them freeze into a statue which could easily be disintegrated by Force push.
